source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The great archive at the end of the world, being erased into white: dark and grand, ominous, endless shelves of forgotten books and a cathedral-like hush. Tempo 76 BPM, 4/4 time, key of G minor. Instrumentation: pipe organ over a chromatic descending bass, soft wordless choir (no words), gong, low strings, distant bells. Form: organ intro, dark theme, quieter choral middle, theme returns heavier. Duration: 95 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
